discovery.inference: Exploratory scan of prior points; fresh primary comparisons below are the confirmation

inference: Bonferroni across 58 approximate mean/accuracy intervals and 20 exact Monte Carlo reference tests; conditional public pseudorandom-seed model. Approximate interval coverage is not an exact guarantee.
limitations: Two fixed Solinas primes, not a population of all Solinas primes
Fresh points on the existing random-field/model pool, not new independent field draws
Only fixed public feature menu, trimmed 256-point prefixes, and finite targeted regions
Official generator chosen once; independent starts are not independently chosen official generators
Zero resolved feature effects do not exclude algebraic structure, rare weaker effects, or greater ECDLP resistance

ml.ml_notes: Feature-only classifier of point walks, not a scalar/key model. Both training and test windows contain 2048 points; fresh seeds and random generators prevent point overlap with training.
